aka.zh: 武汉外环线、武汉外环公路

aka.en: 'China's first city ring' (popular name at its completion)
aka.zh: “中国城市第一环”（建成时的称号）

tagline.en: A 188 km ring round the three towns of Wuhan, closed in 2007 by a suspension bridge across the Yangtze at Yangluo and now being widened to eight lanes
tagline.zh: 环抱武汉三镇的 188 公里环线，2007 年以阳逻长江大桥一跨过江而闭合，如今正分段拓宽为八车道

start.en: Back at Dongxihu, about 188 km round. G4201 is a closed ring; the two ends the page shows are the same point
start.zh: 绕行约 188 公里后回到东西湖。G4201 是闭合环线，页面所示的起终点是同一处

end.en: Dongxihu interchange with the Beijing–Hong Kong–Macau and Shanghai–Chengdu expressways, Dongxihu district — kilometre 0 of the ring
end.zh: 东西湖区东西湖互通，接京港澳高速、沪蓉高速——环线零公里点

en: G4201 is the outer ring of Wuhan, joining the six outer districts of Dongxihu, Huangpi, Xinzhou, Hongshan, Jiangxia and Caidian and the development zones around the city. It crosses the Yangtze twice: by the Yangluo bridge in the north-east and the Junshan bridge in the south-west. When it was closed in 2007 it was described as the longest outer ring yet built round a Chinese city.

It was put together from three parts: the north-east ring from Hongyu village in Dongxihu round to Baoxie in Jiangxia, the Yangluo bridge, and, on the south-west side, a stretch of the Beijing–Zhuhai trunk line, now G4, with the Junshan bridge. It was the place where the Beijing–Zhuhai and Shanghai–Chengdu trunk lines met, and much of it is still shared with them: with G4 and G50 in the south-west, and with G42 and G70 in the north. As a ring it has no termini; Chinese Wikipedia's chainage starts at the Dongxihu interchange and runs clockwise.
zh: G4201 是武汉的外环，连通东西湖、黄陂、新洲、洪山、江夏、蔡甸 6 个区及城市周边各开发区。它两次跨越长江：东北的阳逻长江大桥和西南的军山长江大桥。2007 年闭合时，被称为当时国内城市中建成的最长外环线。
它由三部分组成：自东西湖区红羽村绕至江夏区豹澥镇的东北段、阳逻长江大桥，以及西南侧京珠国道主干线（今 G4）含军山长江大桥的一段。它是京珠、沪蓉两条国道主干线在武汉交汇形成的环线，至今大量路段仍与之共线：西南段与 G4、G50 共线，北段与 G42、G70 共线。作为环线，它没有起终点；中文维基百科的里程自东西湖互通起算，按顺时针方向排列。

en: The ring was built as a four-lane expressway for 120 km/h; the north-east section has a 28-metre roadbed. The Yangluo bridge, which closed it, is a suspension bridge with a 1,280-metre main span across the Yangtze in one leap, six lanes wide, with 2.7 km of main bridge and 7.3 km of approaches; at its opening it was reported as the eighth-longest span in the world and the third in China, and Wuhan's first suspension bridge. The Junshan bridge in the south-west is a cable-stayed bridge with a 460-metre main span and a deck 38.8 metres wide, described in its engineering award record as the widest Yangtze bridge in China when it opened in 2001.

Four lanes are now too few. The Zhongzhou–Beihu section on the east side has already been widened and was handed over on 25 December 2024. Rebuilding of the next 19.6 km, from Canglongdao to the Wuhan South interchange, to eight lanes was launched by Hubei Communications Investment Group on 2 December 2025; work on its key structures began on 12 June 2026, full construction was due to follow in October, and completion is planned for the end of 2028.
zh: 全线按双向四车道、设计时速 120 公里的高速公路标准建设，东北段路基宽 28 米。使环线闭合的阳逻长江大桥为悬索桥，主跨 1280 米，一跨过江，双向六车道，由 2.7 公里主桥和 7.3 公里接线组成；通车时报道称其为世界第八大、国内第三大悬索桥，也是武汉第一座悬索桥。西南的军山长江大桥为斜拉桥，主跨 460 米，钢箱梁宽 38.8 米，其获奖工程资料称，该桥 2001 年通车时为国内最宽的长江大桥。
四车道如今已不敷使用。东段中洲至北湖段已完成改扩建，于 2024 年 12 月 25 日交工。其后藏龙岛至武汉南枢纽的 19.6 公里由湖北交投集团改扩建为八车道，2025 年 12 月 2 日举行开工；2026 年 6 月 12 日控制性工程开工，计划当年 10 月全线铺开施工，2028 年底建成。

en: The first piece is the south-west side, built as part of the Beijing–Zhuhai trunk line. Work on the Junshan bridge began at the end of 1998 or in 1999 — accounts differ — and it opened on 15 December 2001. The north-east ring, about 94 km, was a national key project of the tenth five-year plan; it was begun in July 2001 and opened on 26 December 2004, with the Yangtze still uncrossed at its eastern end.

The Yangluo bridge, begun on 6 November 2003, closed the gap. It opened on 26 December 2007 and the 188 km ring was complete. An official of Wuhan's transport commission said then that the north-east section, carrying 14,000 vehicles a day, was used mostly by cars on short trips and did little to divert through traffic; with the bridge open, tens of thousands of through vehicles a day were expected to bypass the city.
zh: 最早的一段是西南侧，作为京珠国道主干线的一部分修建。军山长江大桥于 1998 年底或 1999 年开工（说法不一），2001 年 12 月 15 日建成通车。东北段全长约 94 公里，属国家“十五”重点建设项目，2001 年 7 月奠基，2004 年 12 月 26 日通车，此时其东端仍未跨过长江。
2003 年 11 月 6 日开工的阳逻长江大桥补上了缺口。大桥于 2007 年 12 月 26 日通车，188 公里的外环全线贯通。武汉市交委一位负责人当时表示，东北段日通车 1.4 万辆，主要是轿车和短途车辆，没有起到很好的过境分流作用；大桥通车后，每天数万辆过境车辆可不必入城。

en: No total for the ring has been published; it was built as three projects, one of them part of another expressway. The north-east section, about 94 km, was estimated at about 3.8 billion yuan. The Yangluo bridge cost about 2 billion. The Junshan bridge was budgeted at 1.3 billion and came in at 861 million at final acceptance; it was paid for as part of the Beijing–Zhuhai trunk line in Hubei, which had a World Bank loan.

The present widening is on a larger scale: about 2.8 billion yuan for the 20.463 km from Zhongzhou to Zhengdian at tender in 2025, given as about 2.793 billion for 19.6 km at the start of work, invested by Hubei Communications Investment Group.
zh: 这条环线没有公开的总造价；它由三个项目组成，其中一个属于另一条高速公路。东北段约 94 公里，概算总投资约 38 亿元；阳逻长江大桥总投资约 20 亿元；军山长江大桥设计概算 13 亿元，竣工验收为 8.61 亿元，作为利用世界银行贷款的京珠国道主干线湖北段的一部分出资建设。
当前的改扩建规模更大：中洲至郑店段招标时按路线全长 20.463 公里、总投资约 28 亿元，开工时为全长约 19.6 公里、总投资约 27.93 亿元，由湖北交投集团投资建设。

en: When the north-east section opened in 2004 it had no mainline toll barriers, only seven toll stations at its ramps, under Hubei's networked tolling. The Yangluo bridge cut the drive from Yangluo to Guanshan, south of the river, from two or three hours by ferry or round by the Second Yangtze Bridge to about twenty minutes.
zh: 2004 年东北段通车时，按全省联网收费要求不设主线收费站，只在沿线设 7 个匝道收费站。阳逻大桥通车后，从阳逻到江南的关山，由原来走汽渡或绕行长江二桥的两三个小时缩短到约 20 分钟。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. The ring was built from 1998 to 2007 as three projects — the north-east section, the Yangluo bridge, and a stretch of the Beijing–Zhuhai trunk line with the Junshan bridge — each costed on its own; the sourced figures are listed separately below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。环线于 1998 至 2007 年间分三个项目建成——东北段、阳逻长江大桥，以及京珠国道主干线含军山长江大桥的一段——各自核算；有来源的数字另列如下。

why.en: Who paid for the north-east section and the Yangluo bridge has not been found; the Junshan bridge was built under the Beijing–Zhuhai trunk line in Hubei, which had a US$400 million World Bank loan. The current widening is invested by Hubei Communications Investment Group, the provincial state-owned transport investor.
why.zh: 东北段和阳逻长江大桥的出资方未查到；军山长江大桥属京珠国道主干线湖北段，该段利用世界银行贷款 4 亿美元。当前的改扩建由省属国有企业湖北交投集团投资建设。

figures.source: Hubei Daily via cnhubei.com, 28 December 2007; Wuhan Evening News, 19 December 2007, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 武汉绕城高速公路

timeline.en: The north-east section is begun in July; the Junshan bridge opens on 15 December.
timeline.zh: 7 月，东北段奠基；12 月 15 日，军山长江大桥建成通车。

timeline.en: Work on the Yangluo Yangtze bridge begins on 6 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 6 日，阳逻长江大桥开工。

timeline.en: The north-east section opens on 26 December.
The Yangluo bridge opens on 26 December and the ring is closed.
timeline.zh: 12 月 26 日，阳逻长江大桥通车，外环全线贯通。

timeline.en: The widened Zhongzhou–Beihu section is handed over on 25 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 25 日，中洲至北湖段改扩建工程交工。

timeline.en: Widening of Zhongzhou–Zhengdian to eight lanes is launched on 2 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 2 日，中洲至郑店段“四改八”工程开工。

timeline.en: Work on Zhongzhou–Zhengdian's key structures begins on 12 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 12 日，中洲至郑店段控制性工程开工。
